create_OPTICS_clustering: create an OPTICS clustering model with min_samples, xi, and min_cluster_size parameters
run_OPTICS_fit: run OPTICS clustering on a dataset and retrieve reachability, core distances, and ordering
build_cluster_optics_dbscan: build DBSCAN-style cluster labels from OPTICS reachability and core distances using an epsilon threshold
generate_reachability_plot: generate a reachability plot showing cluster density variations across ordered samples
visualize_clustering_results: visualize OPTICS and DBSCAN clustering results on 2D scatter plots with color-coded clusters
